# Feature Requirements Quality Checklist: Irrigation Record Capture

**Purpose**: Review SPEC-011 for requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, testability, and scope boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the authorized Business boundary, required Field, and optional same-Field/Business Season all stated as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are online-only creation, server acceptance, and the prohibition on queued/offline acceptance stated consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are accepted records' historical integrity and create/view-only lifecycle boundaries explicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec define the required occurrence time, local input, default, Business timezone fallback, invalid-time rejection, absolute storage, and display timezone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are method, duration, water volume, and note all optional, with duration and volume units and precision explicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, FR-012–013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the explicit exclusions complete: inputs/catalogs, equipment, automation, weather recommendations, photos/attachments, costs, analytics, and generic offline sync? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Is the stable identity, same-actor exact retry, current-authorization requirement, changed-request conflict, and active-flow-only retry boundary clear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the historical read surface identified as the chronological Field Diary with a distinct `IRRIGATION` event and separate record identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec avoid assigning FieldObservation identity or description semantics to irrigation records? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 Do the retry and diary requirements agree with the plan, data model, and OpenAPI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014–015]
- [ ] CHK011 Are positivity and precision rules for duration and water volume objective and unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012–013]

## Acceptance Criteria and Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Can acceptance criteria distinguish server-accepted history from an unconfirmed request outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are unauthorized Field, revoked access, and invalid Season scenarios covered without disclosing protected information? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are offline loss, uncertain HTTP outcome, exact replay, and conflicting identity reuse addressed without durable local retry or reconciliation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, FR-014, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are empty history and loading, connectivity, authorization, validation, and server-error states specified for mobile? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the occurrence-time requirements be objectively accepted for future, ambiguous, nonexistent, and valid Business-local times? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Boundaries

- [ ] CHK017 Are authorization and same-context Season validation assigned to the server rather than trusted to client-supplied Business identity? [Security, Spec §FR-002–003]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the spec and plan consistently exclude irrigation local persistence, offline delivery, automatic retries, reconciliation, and generic sync? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK019 Are occurrence-time display and history association consistent between functional requirements, success criteria, and the Field Diary plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-009, SC-001, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK020 Are product assumptions limited to the stated optional fields, existing authorization, online operation, and historical create/view behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
